column1: # Packages the rig adds to an image before the agent goes on, pinned by sha256: nftables and what it
# needs that the image lacks (Debian's cloud images have no nft). Each file came from
# snapshot.debian.org at 20261104T000000Z, as the pinned image's own apt resolved it (its keyring
# checked the index's signature) and matched by the MD5 that index gave; images.sh fetches them into
# $RIG/debs and checks these sums; rig.sh installs exactly these, together, and nothing else.
